::: {#exr-why-layers}

#### Features of features

lds calls a neural network deep when its
[depth](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/neural-nets.html#def-depth)
gives it more than one hidden layer.
Each hidden layer computes its [features](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature) from the layer before it.
What could a second layer of features describe in a digit
that a first layer, computed straight from the pixels, could not?

:::
